heading: Give it five minutes
body: A short rest lets the flour absorb the liquid and the bubbles form.
points: Heat the iron while you wait
timerLabel: Click here to start a rest timer

labels.statusIdle: Press start when your batter is covered and resting.
labels.statusRunning: Resting. The batter is thickening and the bubbles are forming.
labels.statusDone: Time is up. Your batter is rested and ready to cook.
labels.waffleLabel: A waffle that browns as the timer runs

narration: Let the batter rest for five to ten minutes.
This gives the flour time to absorb the milk and lets bubbles form.
Use the time to heat up your waffle iron.
